title: A Written Segment Matches Its List
statement: Let $\mu,f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $d,n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $L$ be a finite list of integers with length $n$. Suppose that $L_i=f(i)$ for every valid index $i$. After writing the first $n$ values of $f$ into $\mu$ starting at $d$, the resulting sequence represents $L$ starting at $d$.
hypotheses_covered: At every valid list index i, the list entry equals f(i)
replaced:
Let $\mu,f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, and let $d,n\in\mathbb{N}$ and $l$ be a finite list
of integers of length $n$. Suppose that the entry of $l$ at every valid index $i$ is
$f(i)$. Define a new sequence to equal $f(a-d)$ for $d\le a<d+n$ and to equal $\mu(a)$
elsewhere. Its values starting at index $d$ agree with $l$.
